_note: THE LAYERS OF A FIGHT. A pass is a moment and it already has pools;
these are the shapes a fight takes that no single call covered.
battle_three  - three cars, one place. The middle man is in both fights
at once, which is the situation. {a} leads the queue,
{b} is the meat in the sandwich, {c} is behind them.
battle_traded - the same two men swapping a place over and over. {n} is
the number of times it has changed hands, measured, never

battle_escaped.t: And he manages to pull away! {a} holds {pos}, and {b} has run out of answers.
{a} has done it - he defended for {dur} and now there is {gap} in it. That place is his.
That is the fight over. {b} could not find a way past, and now he is {gap} adrift.
Watch the gap: {gap}, and growing. {a} kept his head and kept {pos}.
All that pressure, and {a} has come through it. {b} drops away.
{b} threw everything at that and it was not enough. {gap} now, and the moment has gone.
You have to admire that from {a} - {dur} under siege, and he is clear of it.
The tow is broken. {a} has {gap} in hand and {pos} is settled for now.

battle_three.t: Three cars, one place. {a} leads it, {b} is all over him, and {c} is all over {b}.
It is a queue for {pos} now - {a}, then {b}, then {c}, and nobody is getting a breath.
{b} is the man in trouble here. He cannot go after {a} without handing the door to {c}.
Look at this train: {a}, {b} and {c}, and the whole thing is being decided one corner at a time.
Watch {c} in all this - he is racing two cars at once, and only one of them knows it.
That is three abreast in everything but name. {a} holds {pos}, and he holds it from two of them.
Nobody in this group can afford a mistake. {a} in front, {b} and {c} waiting on exactly that.
The middle of that fight is the worst place to be, and {b} has been sat in it for a while now.

battle_traded.t: And they have swapped it again! {a} back through on {b}, and that is {n} times now.
{a} takes it straight back. These two have traded this place {n} times and neither will settle for it.
Round they go again - {pos} changes hands for the {n}th time, and it is {a} who holds it this second.
Every corner, one of them has a go. {n} changes of position between {a} and {b}, and it is not over.
This has stopped being a pass and started being a war. {a} leads it again, {n} swaps in.
{b} will not accept that. He was past, he is behind again, and {a} has {pos} for now.
You could not separate these two with a crowbar. {n} times that place has moved, and {a} has it.
